project_title: AI-Based Fake Identity & Document Screening System
purpose: Human-in-the-loop screening for suspicious identity documents, synthetic or manipulated document imagery, presentation attacks, document reuse, and identity inconsistencies.
operating_principle: Evidence is fused into a screening recommendation. Final identity acceptance, rejection, or issuer authentication remains a qualified human or authorised issuer decision.
primary_capabilities: Secure upload and document quality gating
OCR, field extraction and document-type/layout checks
Aadhaar layout consistency and QR-content checks
Image forensics, deepfake screening and anomaly signals
Face detection, optional document-to-reference comparison and separate-capture PAD readiness
Fingerprinting, provenance, duplicate/reuse and temporal analysis
Explainable risk drivers, reviewer queue and tamper-evident receipt
